title: James H. Campbell v. Mid-Atlantic Presbytery
disposition_detail: Adopted the Committee of Commissioners on Judicial Business partial report. It ordered Mid-Atlantic Presbytery to schedule, at its next Stated Meeting, a new hearing on the original charges by New Covenant ruling elders against Rev. Robert Schoof under BCO 44-5; charged the Presbytery to conform to the BCO and timely inform all principals; and appointed a Judicial Commission for any complaint or appeal before the Seventh General Assembly. The adopted text does not expressly label the complaint sustained or rule on the late-filing request.
first_summary: Ruling Elder James H. Campbell complained that Mid-Atlantic Presbytery approved a commission report finding charges against Rev. Robert Schoof inadmissible. The General Assembly sustained the complaint, declared the Presbytery's action null and void, and remanded for a new hearing on the original charges.
summary: Ruling Elder James H. Campbell complained that Mid-Atlantic Presbytery approved a commission report finding charges against Rev. Robert Schoof inadmissible rather than proceeding on them. The General Assembly adopted the Committee on Judicial Business recommendation ordering Presbytery to hold a new hearing on the original charges under BCO 44-5, to conform to the BCO, and to keep the principals informed; it also appointed a judicial commission for any further complaint or appeal. The adopted report gives no further reasoning and does not expressly rule on the late-filing request.
